description: Create a new Meeting Attendee record. This associates a user with a meeting.

schema.description: A record associating a Project user with a Meeting, tracking their attendance status.

id.description: Unique identifier for this meeting attendee record. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to update or delete the record via `/rest/v1.0/meeting_attendee_records/{id}`.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting this attendee belongs to. Pass as the `meeting_id` query parameter when updating or deleting the record.

status.description: Attendance status of the user for this meeting. Constrained to the values in the enum.

login_information.description: Identity of the Project user attached to this attendee record.

id.description: Login Information (user) identifier of the attendee.

login.description: Email address the attendee signs in with.

name.description: Full display name of the attendee.

meeting_attendee_record.description: Attributes for the meeting attendee record to create or update.

status.description: Attendance status to set for the user. Constrained to the values in the enum.

login_information_id.description: Login Information (user) ID of the Project user to associate with the Meeting as an attendee.
